title: 第23章 彼岸毒吻轮回蚀骨第24章 残躯坠渊群狼环伺
slug: 噬主成魔万魂幡饮血开锋
content_zh:
玄天剑宗的废墟在身后化作地平线上的一抹血色残影。
阴九幽脚踏万魂王煞剑幡所化的暗金魔虹，撕裂长空，速度远超寻常元婴修士。
九劫雷煌体的力量在血脉中奔涌，万魂幡吞噬玄天剑宗精华后散发的凶威如同实质的魔域，所过之处，云层避散，生灵蛰伏。
然而，他心中并无半分复仇的快意，只有一片冰冷的死寂。
玄天剑宗只是开始，当年退婚大典上的羞辱，家族的无情，父母的囚禁，一路走来的背叛与追杀…
所有仇敌的面孔，如同烙印在魂幡上的符文，在他冰冷的恨焰中无声哀嚎。
下一个目标…林家？
城主府？还是…那隐藏在更高处的黑手？
就在他心神沉凝之际，前方的空间突然泛起一阵奇异的涟漪。
并非攻击，而是一种…牵引？
一股宏大、古老、仿佛贯穿了无尽轮回的意志，如同无形的潮汐，轻轻拂过他的神魂。
这股意志不带敌意，却蕴含着令人心悸的沧桑与威严，让他元婴初期的修为都感到一阵莫名的悸动。
“轮回…之眼？”
阴九幽眉头微蹙，白骨秘境意志崩溃前的警告在脑中回响。
嗡！
他前方的虚空无声裂开，并非空间乱流，而是一条由虚幻的、散发着微弱白光的鹅卵石铺就的小径。
小径两旁，盛开着无边无际、妖异而美丽的红色花朵——彼岸花。
花香馥郁，却带着一种令人沉沦、忘却前尘的诡异力量。
小径的尽头，隐约可见一座横跨在浑浊忘川河上的、古朴苍凉的巨大石桥——奈何桥。
“生魂入轮回，踏过彼岸路。

饮下孟婆汤，前尘皆作古…”
一个空灵、飘渺，仿佛能洗涤灵魂的女声，如同天籁般在小径上响起。
阴九幽眼中恨焰跳动，警惕骤升。
轮回殿？
这传说中的亡者归宿之地，为何向他敞开？是陷阱？
还是…另一场觊觎的开始？
他停在虚空，万魂王煞剑幡在身后无声招展，魂火漩涡缓缓旋转，散发出冰冷的威慑。
“魔君驾临，轮回殿蓬荜生辉。”
那空灵女声再次响起，带着一丝恰到好处的恭敬与好奇。
奈何桥头，一道曼妙的身影缓缓浮现。
她身着素雅的月白长裙，裙裾无风自动，如同笼罩在朦胧的月华之中。
青丝如瀑，仅用一根简单的玉簪挽起，露出光洁的额头和修长的脖颈。
面容清丽绝伦，不施粉黛，却美得惊心动魄，尤其是一双眸子，清澈见底，仿佛蕴藏着万千星辰，流转间带着悲悯众生的温柔。
她赤着双足，踩在虚幻的彼岸花瓣上，纤尘不染。
气息纯净圣洁，宛如九天仙子临凡，修为赫然达到了化神初期！
“孟婆？”
阴九幽冰冷的声音响起，带着一丝审视。
眼前之人，与传说中熬制孟婆汤的老妪形象截然不同。
“魔君唤我‘幽瑶’便可。”
女子微微欠身，声音轻柔，如同春风拂面，“轮回有常，因果循环。

魔君身负滔天因果，煞气冲霄，已惊扰轮回秩序。
殿主感念魔君不易，特命幽瑶在此相候，欲为魔君指一条…化解因果，超脱轮回之苦的明路。”
她目光清澈，落在阴九幽身上，带着一丝恰到好处的怜惜，“这无尽恨火灼魂之苦，想必…很痛吧？”
content_en:
The ruins of Xuantian Sword Sect turned into a bloody afterimage on the horizon behind them.
Yin Jiuyou stepped on the dark golden magic rainbow transformed from the evil sword banner of the Ten Thousand Souls King, tearing the sky apart at a speed far exceeding that of ordinary Nascent Soul cultivators.
The power of the Nine Tribulations Thunder Glory Body surges in the blood. The ferocious power emitted by the Ten Thousand Soul Banner after devouring the essence of the Xuantian Sword Sect is like a real demonic realm. Wherever it passes, the clouds disperse and the creatures are dormant.
However, there was no joy of revenge in his heart, only a cold silence.
The Xuantian Sword Sect was just the beginning. The humiliation at the wedding breakup ceremony, the ruthlessness of the family, the imprisonment of the parents, the betrayal and pursuit along the way...
The faces of all the enemies were like runes imprinted on the soul flag, wailing silently in the cold flames of hatred.
The next target...the Lin family?
City Lord's Mansion? Or...the black hand hidden higher up?
Just as he was concentrating, a strange ripple suddenly appeared in the space in front of him.
Not an attack, but a... pull?
A grand, ancient will that seemed to run through endless reincarnations, like an invisible tide, gently brushed his soul.
This will was not hostile, but contained a heart-stopping vicissitude and majesty that made even his early Nascent Soul cultivation experience an inexplicable throbbing.
"The Eye of Reincarnation?"
Yin Jiuyou frowned slightly, the warning from the White Bone Secret Realm before his will collapsed echoed in his mind.
Buzz!
The void in front of him cracked silently. It was not a turbulent flow of space, but a path paved with illusory cobblestones that emitted a faint white light.
On both sides of the path, endless, eerie and beautiful red flowers - Bianhua flowers bloom.
The fragrance of the flowers is fragrant, but it has a strange power that makes people sink and forget their past.
At the end of the path, you can vaguely see a huge, simple and desolate stone bridge - Naihe Bridge, spanning the turbid Wangchuan River.
“The soul enters reincarnation and walks on the road to the other side.
Drink Meng Po Decoction, and your past will be forgotten..."
An ethereal, ethereal female voice that seemed to be able to cleanse the soul sounded like the sound of nature on the path.
Flames of hatred pulsed in Yin Jiuyou's eyes, and his vigilance suddenly rose.
The Palace of Reincarnation?
Why was this legendary place of death for the dead open to him? Is it a trap?
Or... the beginning of another covetous game?
He stopped in the void, the Ten Thousand Soul King's Evil Sword Flag waved silently behind him, and the soul fire vortex slowly rotated, exuding an icy intimidation.
"The devil has arrived, and the palace of reincarnation is shining brightly."
The ethereal female voice sounded again, with just the right amount of respect and curiosity.
At the end of Naihe Bridge, a graceful figure slowly emerged.
She was wearing a simple and elegant moon-white dress, and the skirt moved freely without wind, as if shrouded in the hazy moonlight.
The green hair is like a waterfall, held up only by a simple hosta, revealing a smooth forehead and slender neck.
The face is extremely beautiful, without makeup, but it is breathtakingly beautiful, especially the pair of eyes, which are so clear that they seem to contain thousands of stars, and they are filled with tenderness of compassion for all living beings.
Her bare feet stepped on the illusory petals on the other side, spotless.
The aura is pure and holy, like a nine-day fairy coming to earth, and his cultivation has reached the early stage of becoming a god!
"Mother Meng?"
Yin Jiuyou's cold voice sounded, with a hint of scrutiny.
The person in front of me is completely different from the image of the old woman who cooked Meng Po soup in legend.
"The Demon Lord can just call me 'You Yao'."
The woman bowed slightly, and her voice was soft, like the spring breeze blowing on her face, "Reincarnation is permanent, and cause and effect cycle.
The demon king is burdened with monstrous cause and effect, and his evil energy is soaring into the sky, disturbing the order of reincarnation.
The master of the palace is grateful for the difficulty of remembering the demon king, so he specially ordered Youyao to wait here, hoping to show the demon king a clear way...to resolve the cause and effect and transcend the suffering of reincarnation. "
Her clear eyes fell on Yin Jiuyou, with a hint of just the right pity, "This pain of endless hatred burning the soul, must be... very painful, right?"
